## Sample kind
LOW_SIGNAL — The passage offers repetitive, generic city imagery without developing a distinctive scene or narrative.

## Grounded reading
The voice is warmly scenic, leaning on familiar images of a lively marketplace balanced by a peaceful park. Its repeated phrases and broad praise of the city leave little sense of a particular speaker or a deeper emotional turn; the reader is mainly invited to enjoy an idealized tableau.

## What the model chose to foreground
The passage foregrounds sensory abundance—jasmine, spices, hot oil, flowers—and the contrast between bustling streets and pockets of tranquility. Its moral emphasis is mild and communal: the city is welcoming, lively, and restorative.

## Evidence line
A silver-haired old lady sat on a porch, her eyes looking out over the city, her soft smile warming the hearts of all who passed by.

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Low — The sample’s repeated stock imagery and near-verbatim refrains make it weak evidence of a distinctive or persistent voice.
